chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazie, from al-Khaybari, from al-Husayn ibn Thuwayr and Abu Salma al-Sarraj, who said:

We heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and he was sending la'an (asking for Allah's wrath) at the end of every prescribed prayer on four from the men and four from the women: So-and-so, and so-and-so, and so-and-so, and Muawiya (and he named them), and so-and-so woman, and so-and-so woman, and Hind, and Umm al-Hakam, the sister of Muawiya.

key_terms.هِنْدٌ: Hind (daughter of Utba, mother of Muawiya)

ai.seo_question: Who did Imam al-Sadiq (as) curse after every prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reciting la'an against four men and four women, specifically naming Muawiya and Hind, immediately after each obligatory prayer. This practice underscores the Shia tradition of linking theological enmity with the Umayyad caliphs to the daily ritual of worship, reinforcing the concept of 'tawalla' (allegiance) and 'tabarra' (disavowal) as integral components of faith. The specific inclusion of Hind, the mother of Muawiya, highlights the familial and political lineage of the Umayyads as objects of divine curse in Shia historiography.
